name: youtube-ai-summarizer
description: Chrome/Brave Extension to summarize YouTube videos and chat with transcripts using local AI (LM Studio, Ollama) or Cloud AI (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI).

scripts.package: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json, background.js, content.js, content.css, main_world.js, popup.html, popup.js, popup.css, README.md, LICENSE, PRIVACY.md, icons -DestinationPath youtube-summarizer-ai-v1.3.0.zip -Force"

author: Hidr4c (https://github.com/Hidr4c)
